text:
deploy-bot: deploy job started: release/2026.03.20_11:23 -> rolling out service: inference-api. Feature flag 'enable_new_reranker' will be toggled in a phased safety window (canary -> gradual). Initial cohort: 1% traffic in us-west-2. Gate: metrics check at +5m and +30m. /cc @alyssa @mike
alyssa: noted. Can we pin the model variant for the canary to model-route-v2a so we isolate changes to the reranker logic?
mike: yes, pinning to v2a for the canary. Metrics to watch: p95 latency delta <5ms, request error rate <0.05%, token cost delta <2%. If any breach -> immediate rollback to flag off.
sre-oncall: holdpoint added — do not advance past 1% until smoke tests pass and heap/GC metrics look stable. I'll watch memory growth and backpressure metrics.
product-evan: quick release note line: "Opt-in reranker for improved relevance; staged rollout with safety checks; backward-compatible defaults." Keep it short for the dashboard.
jamie: running smoke suite now. Command:```./scripts/smoke_check.sh --target inference-api --cohort canary``` sending logs to #eng-oncall. Will paste failures here.
jamie: smoke OK on basic inference, 50 sample queries; reranker output sanity checks passed. No 5xx seen.
deploy-bot: canary update: 1% -> 5% in us-west-2 after holdpoint. Observability hooks enabled: trace sampling 100% for canary, and debug logs for reranker true for 10m.
mike: watch for a subtle metric: top-k reranker latency distribution. If tail >10ms increase, we should cap at 5% and run analysis.
alyssa: agreed. Also note tokenization differences — I saw a 0.7% token count variance in staging earlier; that's within cost gate but worth tracking for embeddings downstream.
sre-oncall: servers stable, GC/RSS normal. No spike in cpu steal. Network errors at 0.003% — fine.
product-evan: recommendation: proceed to 25% next if no regressions at 30m mark. Keep the release note locked with the expected impact metrics.
jamie: pushing 25% rollout command now:```deploy-bot rollout-flag --flag enable_new_reranker --to 25 --region us-west-2 --pin-model model-route-v2a```
deploy-bot: rollout acknowledged. Starting traffic shift to 25% over 10 minutes. Automatic metric gating enabled.
mike: if the cost delta creeps above 3% at 25%, throttle back to 10% and profile. Also if user errors related to ranking confidence increase, hold and notify eng-ml.
alyssa: small request — add a temporary metric for "rerank_confidence_drop" to the dashboard, threshold 0.2. If we breach, we stop the rollout.
sre-oncall: added alert rule and on-call runbook pointer. If triggered, we'll toggle the flag off via emergency toggle and initiate rollback matrix.
jamie: 25% health check done — p95 +2ms, errors unchanged, cost +1.6%. Moving to 50% next at 30m mark per plan.
deploy-bot: rollout reached 50% in us-west-2. Canary region auto-scaling happened once, handled. Note: model pin still active for cohorts.
mike: final reminder — if production telemetry shows confusion signals (search CTR or client-side rerank mismatches) we roll back. Keep manual rollback steps handy:```api call: POST /admin/feature-flags/toggle {"name":"enable_new_reranker","state":"off"}```
alyssa: copying rollback command to runbook and to release thread. Also keeping the model unpin step separate so we don't accidentally unpin before full verification.
product-evan: publishing release note to docs with a short rollback blurb.
sre-oncall: everything green at 60m. If no regressions by 90m, consider global rollout. We'll keep traces for 24h at 10% sampling.
jamie: recording a post-deploy checklist: collect sample queries for 24h, snapshot config, capture endpoints and model-pins.
mike: good. After 24h, we can consider removing model pin and enabling variant for all regions. If any user-impacting metric shows, we revert flag to off and open a postmortem.
deploy-bot: deploy job complete for release/2026.03.20_11:23. Final state: enable_new_reranker at 50% in us-west-2; global = false. Alerts/guards active. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
